dedupe_keys.name: global one kilometre ssp population projections 2020 2100

description: The SSP gridded-population research team publishes global population projections at thirty arc-seconds, approximately one kilometre, for 248 countries or areas. Random-forest estimates distribute national Shared Socioeconomic Pathway totals at five-year intervals from 2020 to 2100 using WorldPop inputs. The current Figshare version 3 provides five scenario ZIP archives and a README, with free access under CC BY 4.0. These grids can set future demand and population-exposure scenarios for transport, water, energy and public-service simulations. They relate directly to data-worldpop-global-gridded-population as a source and comparison baseline. A caveat is that agreement with national SSP totals does not establish the accuracy of local future settlement patterns. Version selection matters because the provider explicitly recommends the latest release. The spatial projections and archive contents were not downloaded or independently validated.
